(A) [0.6260, 0.8002, 0.7576, 0.9318]
(B) [0.1329, 0.0528, 0.2645, 0.1844]
(C) [0.2374, 0.5935, 0.3690, 0.7251]
(D) No defect in any of the above regions.

Answer with only the correct option letter.
